evals.expected_output: Resolves the remaining union from journal.answers.presets minus qa, classifies every journaled file, and removes only what no remaining role claims — the five QA agent contracts and the two QA guides — while retaining the ~33 shared templates developer still lists. Re-renders CLAUDE.md's managed block, PATTERNS.md, ai-policy.md and agent-registry.md because ROLE_PRESETS_ACTIVE and the QA guide rows changed. Asks before lowering HITL from strict. Ends with a doctor re-run and a per-file report.

assertions.name: set-difference-not-deletion
assertions.description: Templates listed by qa but also listed by developer are retained; only IDs absent from the remaining union are removed.

assertions.name: retained-files-rerendered
assertions.description: CLAUDE.md, PATTERNS.md, ai-policy.md and agent-registry.md are re-rendered even though they are kept, because union-derived values inside them changed.

assertions.name: journal-entries-deleted
assertions.description: Removed files lose their journal.files entry outright rather than being tombstoned, so doctor Check 1 stays green and the journal matches a fresh narrower install.

evals.expected_output: Prints the full plan — per-bucket classification, the files that would be removed, the ones retained and which remaining role claims them, the .claude/settings.json diff and any git-hook actions — and writes nothing at all.

assertions.name: no-mutations
assertions.description: No file is created, modified or deleted; the journal, the scorecard and .git/hooks/ are untouched.

assertions.name: plan-is-complete
assertions.description: The dry run shows the same decisions a real run would make, including the settings diff and out-of-tree hook actions, not just a file list.

evals.prompt: /agentic-uninstall developer. This repo has presets portfolio and developer, and .agentic/agents/blind-code-reviewer.md has local edits.
evals.expected_output: The git layer leaves the union, so the settings entries wiring the removed hooks are dropped BEFORE those hook scripts are deleted, .git/hooks/pre-commit is removed and any pre-commit.local restored. The hand-edited contract is not deleted: it raises a keep/delete/set-aside prompt defaulting to keep, and keeping it flips its journal owner to user.

assertions.name: unwire-before-delete
assertions.description: Settings are written first so no window exists where a hook is wired but its script is missing, which would exit 2 on every event and block all tool use.

assertions.name: user-edited-never-auto-deleted
assertions.description: The modified file defaults to keep and is only removed on an explicit choice; keeping it flips owner to user and is reported as a divergence.

assertions.name: foreign-hook-restored
assertions.description: A pre-commit.local displaced at install time is moved back to pre-commit, so the repo's own hook runs again.

evals.prompt: /agentic-uninstall qa. The repo's journal has adoption.mode == "adopt-existing".
evals.expected_output: Refuses to delete anything. Runs the classification and prints what would be removed if the files were ours, converges only the recomputed answers and the journal/scorecard/settings bookkeeping, and resolves every path from journal.adoption rather than a hardcoded .agentic/.

assertions.name: adopted-is-immutable
assertions.description: Entries with origin adopted-existing or owner user are never rendered, replaced, regenerated or deleted — the same rule agentic-upgrade already states.

assertions.name: reports-rather-than-refusing-silently
assertions.description: The run explains why nothing was deleted and what it would have removed, instead of exiting with no output.

evals.prompt: /agentic-uninstall qa. This repo was installed with qa only, so removing it empties the preset list.
evals.expected_output: Stops and explains that removing the last role is the whole-layer case, which must be asked for explicitly with --all. Nothing is changed.

assertions.name: last-preset-needs-explicit-all
assertions.description: An empty remaining union is not silently treated as a full uninstall; the run stops and names the --all flag.
